firmware.notes: XUSB Falcon firmware for xhci-tegra (drivers/usb/host/xhci-tegra.c requests nvidia/tegra210/xusb.bin at probe). Every USB host port on the Nano sits behind XUSB, so without it there is no USB host at all. Licence: Redistributable, LICENCE.nvidia (WHENCE, xhci-tegra entry). The blob was last changed by linux-firmware commit 520d85beec013a29ac365871c621916c221c901f ('Update Tegra210 XUSB firmware to v50.29'; WHENCE still says v50.24); the pin is the 20261019 tag's commit, and the blob is byte-identical at both (sha256 verified by independent download from git.kernel.org and the gitlab.com/kernel-firmware mirror on 2026-11-01, bean gosd-cxio).
